bullets.text: Ran and inspected a supplied Python notebook to load provided news records, then edited simple filters and loops with step-by-step guidance.

Under supervision, joined document identifiers to metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records; executed and inspected supplied notebooks to visualize group comparisons and documented missing-data handling.

As an individual contribution to a supervised team project, wrote Python functions to parse provided programming-question records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Under supervision, validated SQL joins with duplicate-key and unmatched-record checks, and visualized how group comparisons changed under alternative cleaning rules.
